|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Occupied Territory (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). * '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.4 release sheet (official text as of 16 December 2011): “Deploy on a battleground. If you occupy, during battle here or at a related location, may place this Effect in Used Pile and choose: Draw up to two cards from Reserve Deck OR Prevent opponent from drawing any destinies during the power segment of that battle (except battle destiny).”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_4.pdf Virtual Block 7.4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 16 December 2011"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223114/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_4.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 29) prints this text again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Occupied Territory (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Occupied Territory (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 December 2012) changed “Prevent opponent from drawing any destinies” to “Prevent any destinies from being drawn” (no destinies may be drawn by either player): “Deploy on a battleground. If you occupy, during battle here or at a related location, may place this Effect in Used Pile and choose: Draw up to two cards from Reserve Deck OR Prevent any destinies from being drawn during the power segment of that battle (except battle destiny).”.<ref name="cl-1274_7-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] (Internet Archive)</ref>
